items.question: Is {brand} secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption to protect your data and never store your login information. Plus, our biometric authentication adds an extra layer of security.

items.question: Can I use {brand} on multiple devices?
items.answer: Absolutely! Your Finwise account syncs seamlessly across all your devices - smartphone, tablet, and computer.

items.question: Can I connect all my bank accounts?
items.answer: Yes! {brand} supports connections with over 10,000 financial institutions worldwide. Simply log in through our secure portal to link your accounts.

items.question: Do I need any financial expertise to use the investing features?
items.answer: Not at all! Our expert-curated portfolios and educational resources make investing accessible to everyone, regardless of experience level.

items.question: What if I need help using the app?
items.answer: Our dedicated support team is available 24/7 via chat or email. Plus, we offer extensive in-app tutorials and a comprehensive knowledge base to help you make the most of Finwise.
